objective: Activate the §312 evidence-recovery mechanism operationally and prove the BR-5 closure gate.
outcome: ACTIVATED. The scheduled path runs both halves and reports AGGREGATE HEALTHY. Every BR-5 closure requirement is now operational.

sourceCredential.name: insite-evidence-recovery-reader
sourceCredential.permission: Object Read only — console text: 'Allows the ability to read and list objects in specific buckets.'
sourceCredential.bucketScope: Apply to specific buckets only -> insite-production (verified from the selected chip, not from the option list)
sourceCredential.boundaryCheckBeforeCreation: The form defaulted to 'Apply to all buckets in this account', which would have violated the boundary. It was changed to specific-buckets-only and the selected chip was verified as insite-production ALONE before submitting.

secretHandling.transitMethod: Console copy control -> system clipboard -> shell read -> the 0600 file. Only lengths and shapes (32-hex, 64-hex) were ever observed; no value was rendered into a tool result, screenshot, log or message. The clipboard was cleared before and after each capture.
secretHandling.blockedApproachRecorded: An automated route — reading the credential from the page with JavaScript and POSTing it to a local receiver — was attempted and BLOCKED by a safety classifier as a browser-exfiltration pattern. That refusal was correct: it is exactly the shape of a credential-exfiltration attack, and it was not worked around. The intended console copy control was used instead.

sourceCredentialProof.total: 19 passed, 0 failed. Every denial checked to be a genuine 403; an ambiguous failure was defined in advance as NOT a pass.

positive.digestResult: PASS — every object's sha256 and byte length equal the authoritative expectation recorded at §311/§312

negative.cannotAdministerProduction: PASS — AccessDenied 403 on GetBucketVersioning and PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration

sourceCredentialProof.overwriteProbeSafety: The overwrite refusal was tested against an EXISTING customer object key deliberately — the point is that the credential cannot touch it — and the refusal was 403, so no customer object was written. Source integrity was re-measured afterwards: 5 objects, 166708 bytes, unchanged.

aggregateHealthComposition.rule: HEALTHY only when the database half is HEALTHY and the evidence half is PROTECTED.
aggregateHealthComposition.whyItExists: Between §311A and §312A the scheduled run exited 0 every night while customer evidence was entirely unprotected, because the database backup had succeeded. A green light meaning 'half your recovery posture is fine' is worse than no light. NOT_ACTIVATED is explicitly not a passing state.

defectFoundAndFixedInSection312A.what: The evidence reconciler's scan-incomplete branch exited 2 WITHOUT dispatching an alert.
defectFoundAndFixedInSection312A.why it mattered: That branch covers source unavailable, destination unavailable, unreadable ledger and bad credential — the single most important failure class, 'I cannot see what I am supposed to be protecting'. A monitor that goes quiet exactly when it loses sight of its subject is worse than no monitor.
defectFoundAndFixedInSection312A.howFound: By running the MO-1 failure test rather than by reading the code.
defectFoundAndFixedInSection312A.fix: The branch now dispatches evidence.recovery_scan_incomplete carrying the failure KIND only, then exits 2.
defectFoundAndFixedInSection312A.proven: alert dispatch {"dispatched":true,"status":200}; the full suite re-run afterwards, 22/22.

residualRisksCarriedForward.rpo: The machine-local scheduler cannot run while the machine is shut down. Measured: 644 wakes over 8 days, longest gap 16.0h, no day without one. An extended powered-off period would violate the 24h RPO AND prevent the local monitor from reporting it. Registered, not an SLA.
residualRisksCarriedForward.operatorError: The insite-backups-operator credential can delete recovery copies. Bucket Lock on insite-backups was considered and DECLINED because it would block erasure propagation and make a customer deletion impossible to honour within the recovery window — trading a privacy obligation for a durability gain.
residualRisksCarriedForward.contentMismatchDetection: A content divergence at equal byte length on a never-captured object is reported LIVE_UNBACKED until the first capture hashes it. Stated rather than hidden.
residualRisksCarriedForward.dataAccessLogs: Still off and still gated on this plan. Forensics, not recovery — BR-5 closure does not rest on them.
